_mode_values.off: assign an arm and log it; inject NOTHING. Content identical for every session. THIS IS THE SHIPPING STATE.
_mode_values.live: arm A receives the relocated rulings re-injected. Do NOT set until the stubs exist, or arm A gets them twice.

_salt_note: Pins the randomization. Changing it re-randomizes every session and is a NEW experiment, not a continuation.
_relocated_note: The seven founder rulings of 2026-08-20. 21,687 B, 44.8% of the .claude/rules/ channel.
outcome_measure: citation misplacement (CITE-WRONG / substance-holds), NOT substance refutation
_outcome_note: Run 3 measured substance refutation at 1.7% -- a floor needing ~1,349 claims per arm to detect a doubling. Citation misplacement runs at 8.8% and needs ~232. See .claude/workstream/evidence/claim-survival-baseline-2026-08-20.md.
analysis: permutation test, session as the unit; A-failopen sessions reported separately and never folded into A
